       <p>I am a Data Science engineering student at ENSAI specializing in Génie Statistiques - Machine Learning &amp; AI. I build quantitative models, reproducible analytics, and practical decision-support tools.</p>

       <p>My personal project track documents progression: experimentation, learning, stronger modelling practices, improved evaluation, better engineering discipline, and more reproducible delivery.</p>
       <p>I am currently specializing in Statistical Engineering at ENSAI (Rennes, France), with a strong orientation toward Bayesian modelling, decision support, and applied software engineering.</p>

<script>
  const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');

  function toggleDrawer(force) { const open = typeof force === 'boolean' ? force : !mobileDrawer.classList.contains('open'); mobileDrawer.classList.toggle('open', open); drawerBackdrop.classList.toggle('open', open); menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false'); document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : ''; }
  menuToggle?.addEventListener('click', () => toggleDrawer()); drawerBackdrop?.addEventListener('click', () => toggleDrawer(false)); document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Escape') toggleDrawer(false); });
</script>
